functions.name: twitch_numeric_id
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.twitch_numeric_id(p_id text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE WHEN btrim(coalesce(p_id,'')) ~ '^(miu:)?[0-9]+$'
    THEN coalesce(nullif(ltrim(regexp_replace(btrim(p_id),'^miu:',''),'0'),''),'0') END;
$function$
